claims: Jessie Buckley won the Oscar for Best Actress at the 98th Academy Awards in March 2026 for her role as Agnes in the film Hamnet.
Jessie Buckley is the first Irish woman to win the Oscar for Best Actress.
The Best Actress nominees for 2026 were Rose Byrne (If I Had Legs I'd Kick You), Kate Hudson (Song Sung Blue), Renate Reinsve (Sentimental Value), and Emma Stone (Bugonia).
Hamnet is an adaptation of Maggie O'Farrell's novel.
Jessie Buckley won the Golden Globe for her role as Agnes in Hamnet.
Jessie Buckley won the BAFTA for her role as Agnes in Hamnet.
Jessie Buckley won the Critics Choice for her role as Agnes in Hamnet.
Jessie Buckley won the SAG Award for her role as Agnes in Hamnet.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony date was March 15, 2026.
